slides.heading: Worth getting checked if

caption:
Paddled out feeling great, drove home with sore shoulders and a stiff back?

Kayaking and paddleboarding are fantastic summer exercise, but the first few outings often ask more of your shoulders and back than they're used to.

A few tweaks usually help: turn through your trunk rather than pulling with your arms, keep the paddle close, soften your knees on a SUP, and build up from 30 to 45 minutes over several trips. 🏄

Shoulder pain that wakes you at night, weakness lifting your arm or pins and needles in the hand are worth assessing. Our Sydney CBD and Chatswood physios can help. Book online via the link in bio.

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
